queries.capability: control windows from command line CLI
queries.quote: CLI first (manpages and shell completion included)
queries.en: I want to script window layout changes on my Mac from the shell, with commands I can chain in scripts and shell completion.
queries.zh: 我想在 Mac 上用 shell 指令腳本控制視窗排列，最好有 CLI 指令和 shell completion 可以串接使用。

queries.capability: plain text dotfiles configuration
queries.quote: Plain text configuration (dotfiles friendly). See: [default-config.toml]
queries.en: Looking for a Mac window manager configured through a plain TOML text file I can keep in my dotfiles repo.
queries.zh: 想找一個 Mac 視窗管理工具，可以用 TOML 純文字設定檔來設定，方便放進我的 dotfiles repo 管理。

queries.capability: analyze images passed in chat messages
queries.quote: - **Vision**: put an image path or URL in a message
queries.en: I want a local AI assistant that can look at an image file or URL I paste into the chat and answer questions about it.
queries.zh: 想找一個可以在本機跑的 AI 助理，能直接讀我貼上的圖片路徑或 URL 並回答相關問題。

queries.capability: write JSON report of agent run
queries.quote: `--report FILE` | With `-m`: write a JSON report of the run (reply, tool calls, tokens, transcript)
queries.en: After a scripted agent run, I need a report file listing the reply, tool calls, token usage and full transcript.
queries.zh: 用腳本跑 AI agent 之後，想輸出一份 JSON report，裡面要有回覆、tool calls、token 用量和完整 transcript。

queries.capability: track token usage, quota and estimated cost
queries.quote: | `alc usage [weekly\|monthly\|yearly]` | Accounts/quota, the compatibility ledger, and daily token/cost statistics; a tabbed dashboard on a terminal;
queries.en: I want one dashboard showing how much of my ChatGPT and Claude plan quota is left and my daily token spend and estimated cost across coding agents.
queries.zh: 想要一個 dashboard 同時看 ChatGPT 跟 Claude 方案剩多少 quota，還有各 coding agent 每天的 token 用量和估算花費。

queries.capability: measure time-to-first-token and tokens per second
queries.quote: | `alc tps` | Client-observed TTFT and estimated/E2E tokens per second; a dashboard on a terminal;
queries.en: How can I measure TTFT and tokens-per-second throughput for the LLM requests my coding agent makes?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以量測 coding agent 發出的 LLM 請求的 TTFT 跟每秒 token 數 throughput？

queries.capability: Kanban board for to-dos
queries.quote: alt="AppFlowy Kanban Board for To-dos"
queries.en: I want an open source app where I can track my to-dos on a kanban board and drag cards between columns.
queries.zh: 想找一個開源的 app，可以用 kanban 看板管理待辦事項，拖拉卡片換欄位。

queries.capability: comments on database rows
queries.quote: alt="Database row page with comments"
queries.en: Need a tool where my team can leave comments on individual rows of a project tracker table.
queries.zh: 需要一個工具讓團隊可以在專案追蹤表的每一列留言討論。

queries.capability: custom vocabulary prompt for names and jargon
queries.quote: **Custom vocabulary** — `--prompt "Pitakpong, babelscribe"` gives whisper an initial prompt that biases the spelling of names and jargon.
queries.en: I need speech transcription where I can supply a custom vocabulary so people's names and technical jargon get spelled correctly.
queries.zh: 想找可以自訂詞彙的語音轉文字工具，讓人名和專業術語能被正確拼寫。

queries.capability: JSON output with token-level timings
queries.quote: **Outputs** — `srt`, `vtt`, `txt`, `json` (segments with token timings).
queries.en: How can I transcribe a recording into JSON that includes segment and token timings for further processing?
queries.zh: 想把錄音轉成含 segment 和 token 時間戳的 JSON 檔，方便後續程式處理，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: Home Assistant voice conversation agent
queries.quote: adds the seat as an Assist conversation agent, and its field's readings as sensors.
queries.en: I want a local AI voice assistant inside Home Assistant that remembers past conversations and can control my house devices.
queries.zh: 想在 Home Assistant 裡加一個本地 AI 語音助理，能記住之前的對話，還能控制家裡的裝置。

queries.capability: share memory across team via Couchbase
queries.quote: Share chosen entities with publish.
queries.en: How can my team share AI agent memory through a Couchbase bucket without overwriting each other's knowledge?
queries.zh: 團隊想透過 Couchbase bucket 共享 AI agent 的記憶，又不會互相覆蓋，有什麼工具可以做到？

queries.capability: machine-readable raw output for scripting
queries.quote: -r, --raw                        Machine friendlier output
queries.en: I need a terminal tool that prints per-process network traffic in a raw, machine-friendly text format so I can parse it from a script.
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以把每個 process 的網路流量用 raw、方便 script parse 的格式輸出？

queries.capability: monitor a specific network interface
queries.quote: -i, --interface <INTERFACE>      The network interface to listen on, eg. eth0
queries.en: How can I see which programs are using traffic on just the eth0 interface of my Linux server?
queries.zh: 想只看 Linux server 上 eth0 這個 interface 是哪些程式在吃流量，要用什麼工具？

queries.capability: auto-hide when apps go fullscreen
queries.quote: 外部程序全屏时，她会自动躲起来，结束后再回到桌面。
queries.en: I want a desktop mascot that automatically hides whenever I run a game or video fullscreen, then comes back afterward.
queries.zh: 想找一個桌面寵物，在我開全螢幕遊戲或影片時會自動隱藏，結束後再回來。

queries.capability: pause local model on battery power
queries.quote: 笔记本电脑离开电源时，鱼鱼可以自动停止模型推理并把模型移出内存，帮主人照顾续航
queries.en: Is there a desktop assistant whose local AI model unloads from memory automatically when my laptop switches to battery to save power?
queries.zh: 有沒有桌面助理在筆電拔掉電源改用電池時，會自動停止本地模型並釋放記憶體來省電？

queries.capability: run DSP remotely with web browser UI
queries.quote: This is particularly interesting for running Cardinal on embed systems, being controlled remotely via a web browser or a native desktop application.
queries.en: I want to run a modular synth on an embedded board and control its patch remotely from a web browser on my laptop.
queries.zh: 想在 embedded 板子上跑模組合成器，然後從筆電的瀏覽器遠端控制 patch，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: send CV signals between plugin and DAW
queries.quote: This variant provides 8 audio inputs and outputs and 10 CV inputs and outputs.
queries.en: I need a synth plugin that exposes real CV inputs and outputs to my DAW so I can route control voltage between tracks.
queries.zh: 有沒有合成器 plugin 能提供真正的 CV 輸入輸出埠，讓我在 DAW 裡的軌道之間傳 CV 訊號？

queries.capability: convert Hugging Face checkpoints to MLX
queries.quote: Point at a Hugging Face checkpoint or local directory and convert it to MLX with optional runtime-specific compression settings.
queries.en: I have a Hugging Face model checkpoint and want to convert it to MLX format so it runs well on my M2 Mac. What can do that with progress shown?
queries.zh: 我想把 Hugging Face 上的模型 checkpoint 轉成 MLX 格式，在我的 M2 Mac 上跑，有什麼工具可以做而且能看到轉換進度？

queries.capability: compare HTML generation across multiple models
queries.quote: HTML Challenge — 2-4 model slots, each with own thinking mode + reasoning effort + seed, all answering the same prompt with sandboxed live HTML previews
queries.en: I want to give the same prompt to several local models and see their generated HTML pages rendered side-by-side with live previews.
queries.zh: 想把同一個 prompt 丟給幾個本地模型，讓它們各自產生 HTML 網頁，並排顯示即時預覽來比較，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: audit and fix accessibility issues
queries.quote: | [`a11y-debugging`](./skills/a11y-debugging)               | Audit and fix accessibility issues.             |
queries.en: I want my AI agent to audit my web page for accessibility problems in a real browser and help me fix them.
queries.zh: 想讓 AI agent 在真實瀏覽器裡幫我檢查網頁的 accessibility 問題，並協助修正。

queries.capability: debug cookies, sessions and authentication
queries.quote: | [`cookie-debugging`](./skills/cookie-debugging)           | Debug cookies, sessions, and authentication.    |
queries.en: My login keeps failing on my web app; I need an agent to inspect browser cookies and sessions to debug the authentication.
queries.zh: 我的網站登入一直失敗，想讓 AI 幫我檢查瀏覽器的 cookies 和 session，找出 authentication 問題。

queries.capability: verify build provenance attestations of artifacts
queries.quote: $ gh at verify -R cli/cli gh_2.62.0_macOS_arm64.zip
queries.en: How can I verify the build provenance attestation of a downloaded release zip to confirm it was built by the expected repository workflow?
queries.zh: 要怎麼驗證下載的 release zip 的 build provenance attestation，確認它真的是由指定 repo 的 workflow 建置出來的？

queries.capability: install agent skills for coding agents
queries.quote: An [agent skill](https://agentskills.io) is available for driving `gh` from coding agents. Install or update it with the built-in `gh skill` command:
queries.en: I want to install and update an agent skill so my coding agent can operate GitHub repositories from the command line.
queries.zh: 想幫我的 coding agent 安裝並更新一個 agent skill，讓它能從命令列操作 GitHub repo，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: migrate chats and data from Jan app
queries.quote: On first launch, you can **copy** your Jan data into Flint, **reuse** it in place, **move** it (a backup is kept), or **start fresh**.
queries.en: I've been using the Jan app for local LLM chats. Is there a desktop alternative that can migrate my existing Jan data and conversations over?
queries.zh: 我原本用 Jan 跑本地 LLM 聊天，有沒有其他桌面 app 可以直接把 Jan 的資料和對話搬過去？

queries.capability: track token usage, cost and spend budgets
queries.quote: **Usage and cost:** token and prompt-cache counts per message and session, spend budgets, and a dashboard.
queries.en: I want an AI chat app that shows token usage and cost per session and lets me set spend budgets for cloud models.
queries.zh: 想找一個 AI 聊天 app，可以看每個 session 的 token 用量和花費，還能設定雲端模型的預算上限。

queries.capability: separate vocals and stems from songs
queries.quote: Vocal removal & 4-stem separation (drums, bass, other, vocals) via HTDemucs
queries.en: I want to strip the vocals out of an mp3 and split it into drums, bass, and other stems, running locally on my AMD GPU.
queries.zh: 我想把一首 mp3 的人聲去掉，拆成鼓、貝斯等 stems，最好能在本機 AMD 顯卡上跑。

queries.capability: voice-over generation with voice cloning
queries.quote: Expressive AI voice-over with voice cloning (Qwen3-TTS / VoxCPM2 / Drama 3 / KittenTTS2, −16 LUFS)
queries.en: I need an offline TTS tool that can clone a speaker from a wav sample and produce expressive voice-over lines.
queries.zh: 有沒有可以離線跑的 TTS，能用一段 wav 樣本做聲音 cloning，產生有情緒的旁白配音？

queries.capability: download GGUF models from Hugging Face
queries.quote: Then run a local GGUF, download one from Hugging Face, or open the TUI:
queries.en: I want to download a GGUF model from a Hugging Face repo with verified hashes and resumable transfers, then serve it locally.
queries.zh: 想從 Hugging Face repo 下載 GGUF 模型，要能驗證 hash、斷線續傳，下載完直接在本機跑起來。

queries.capability: benchmark and auto-tune llama-server flags
queries.quote: ggrun model.gguf --ai-tune       # measure safe flag variants and cache the winner
queries.en: Is there a tool that benchmarks different llama-server flags for my model and automatically keeps the fastest configuration?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以幫我 benchmark 各種 llama-server 參數組合，然後自動保存最快的設定？

queries.capability: convert videos to GIF from Finder Quick Action
queries.quote: Convert videos to GIFs directly from Finder using the built-in [Quick Action](https://support.apple.com/en-mz/guide/mac-help/mchl97ff9142/mac) shortcut.
queries.en: Is there a way to right-click a video in Finder and turn it into an animated image without opening an app?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法在 Finder 對影片按右鍵用 Quick Action 直接轉成動圖，不用開 app？

queries.capability: crop video when making GIF
queries.quote: Gifski has a bunch of settings like changing dimensions, speed, frame rate, quality, cropping, looping, and more.
queries.en: I want to crop a region of a screen recording on my Mac and export just that part as an animated image.
queries.zh: 我想在 Mac 上把螢幕錄影 crop 一部分，然後只把那塊匯出成動圖。

queries.capability: manage GitHub Gists
queries.quote: | `gists` | GitHub Gist related tools |
queries.en: I want my AI assistant to read and create GitHub Gists for me, like fetching a snippet I saved in a gist.
queries.zh: 我想讓 AI 助理幫我讀取和建立 GitHub Gist，例如抓取我之前存在 gist 裡的程式碼片段。

queries.capability: manage repository rulesets and custom properties
queries.quote: Repository governance tools for managing rulesets and custom properties at the repository, organization, and en
queries.en: Can an AI agent help me manage branch rulesets and custom properties across my GitHub organization's repositories?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法讓 AI agent 幫我管理 GitHub 組織底下各 repo 的 rulesets 和 custom properties？

queries.capability: display output in external pager
queries.quote:
CLI output can be displayed in your preferred pager with the `-p` flag. This defaults
to the ANSI-aware `less -r` if `$PAGER` is not explicitly set.
queries.en: How can I view a formatted .md document in the terminal and scroll through it with less or my $PAGER?
queries.zh: 想在終端機看排版過的 .md 文件，並用 less 或自己設定的 $PAGER 分頁捲動，有什麼工具？

queries.capability: fetch README from GitLab repository
queries.quote: # Fetch README from GitHub / GitLab
queries.en: I want to read a GitLab project's README nicely formatted right in my terminal without opening a browser.
queries.zh: 想直接在終端機漂亮地顯示 GitLab 專案的 README，不用開瀏覽器，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: analyze git diff for change risk
queries.quote: Что сломает эта правка: git diff → задетые методы → радиус поражения с оценкой риска
queries.en: Given a git diff of my 1C code changes, which methods are affected and what's the blast radius and risk level?
queries.zh: 給一份 1C 程式碼的 git diff，想知道會影響哪些 method、波及範圍有多大、風險高不高。

queries.capability: find reports reading a register (DCS)
queries.quote: И в обратную сторону: какие отчёты читают регистр — то, что заденет его правка (`object(parts=["dcs_readers"])`).
queries.en: In a 1C configuration, which reports read a specific accumulation register, so I know what breaks if I change it?
queries.zh: 在 1C 設定裡，想查哪些報表會讀取某個 register，改動它之前先知道會影響哪些報表。

queries.capability: share and install community widgets from hub
queries.quote: More weird stuff on [HiveHub](https://hivehub.griiken.workers.dev/), or ask your agent to make some.
queries.en: Is there a community hub where I can browse and install widgets other people made for my AI agent workspace?
queries.zh: 有沒有社群 hub 可以瀏覽並安裝別人做好的 widget，放進我的 AI agent 工作區？

queries.capability: control agents from scripts via API
queries.quote:
With `hive ctl` an agent starts, reads and steers other agents.
  Your scripts can too, through the API.
queries.en: I want my own scripts to start coding agents and read their output through an API. What desktop app supports that?
queries.zh: 我想用自己的 scripts 透過 API 啟動 coding agent 並讀取它們的輸出，有什麼桌面 app 可以做到？

queries.capability: answer Claude Code sessions by voice
queries.quote: Your Claude Code and Codex sessions report to the Desk through agent hooks.
queries.en: I run several Claude Code and Codex sessions; I want a dashboard showing which are blocked and let me answer them by speaking.
queries.zh: 我同時跑好幾個 Claude Code 和 Codex session，想要一個面板看哪些卡住了，還能用講話回覆它們。

queries.capability: auto-record calendar meetings
queries.quote: Turn it on for calendar events with meeting links: all of them, or only those linked to a Room.
queries.en: Is there a local app that connects to my calendar and automatically starts recording meetings that have a meeting link?
queries.zh: 有沒有本機工具可以連我的行事曆，遇到有會議連結的活動就自動開始錄音？

queries.capability: use Claude Code login as agent provider
queries.quote: This provider uses the Claude Code CLI already installed and signed in on the same machine. There is no API key
queries.en: I want an agent harness that uses my existing Claude Code CLI login as the model provider instead of an API key.
queries.zh: 我想找一個 agent 工具，可以直接用我本機已登入的 Claude Code CLI 當模型 provider，不用 API key。

queries.capability: branch agent sessions from any timeline point
queries.quote:
every session is an event timeline that is
  compact to store and fast to replay, and you can branch from any point.
queries.en: Is there an AI agent tool where I can replay a session's history and branch off from any earlier point?
queries.zh: 有沒有 AI agent 工具可以重播 session 歷史，並從任意時間點 branch 出新的對話？

queries.capability: edit notes in external text editor
queries.quote: can be copied, tagged and modified either from the applications directly or from your own text editor
queries.en: Is there a notes app that lets me open and edit my notes in my own external text editor like Vim or VS Code?
queries.zh: 有沒有筆記軟體可以讓我用自己的外部編輯器（像 Vim 或 VS Code）直接編輯筆記？

queries.capability: SSH agent key integration
queries.quote: SSH Agent integration
queries.en: I want my password vault to load my SSH keys into ssh-agent automatically when I unlock it. What can do that?
queries.zh: 有沒有密碼管理工具可以在解鎖時自動把 SSH key 載入 ssh-agent？

queries.capability: password health and breach reports
queries.quote: Database reports (password health, HIBP, and statistics)
queries.en: I need to check which of my saved passwords are weak, reused, or breached according to Have I Been Pwned.
queries.zh: 我想檢查我存的密碼有哪些太弱、重複使用，或已經在 HIBP 外洩資料裡出現過。

queries.capability: speaker diarization of meeting recordings
queries.quote: `kesha --json --speakers meeting.m4a` stamps each segment with a `speaker` id
queries.en: I have a meeting recording with several people talking. I need a local tool that transcribes it and labels which speaker said each segment.
queries.zh: 我有一段多人開會的錄音，想在本機轉成文字，並標出每段是哪位講者說的，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: export synthesized speech as OGG/Opus voice notes
queries.quote: kesha say "Hello" --format ogg-opus --out hi.ogg  # OGG/Opus — messenger voice notes
queries.en: How can I turn a text reply into an OGG Opus voice note offline so my bot can send it in a messenger?
queries.zh: 想把文字回覆離線轉成 OGG Opus 格式的語音訊息，讓我的 bot 能在通訊軟體裡傳送，有什麼工具可以用？

queries.capability: threaded messaging between agents
queries.quote: Threaded messaging with sender-side internal delivery confirmation
queries.en: I need my AI agents to send each other threaded messages with an inbox and delivery confirmation. What can do that over MCP?
queries.zh: 我想讓多個 AI agent 之間互傳 threaded messages，要有 inbox 跟送達確認，有什麼 MCP 工具可以做到？

queries.capability: schedule reminders and delayed command execution
queries.quote: Reminders and scheduled verb execution
queries.en: Is there an MCP server that lets my agent set reminders and schedule operations to run later?
queries.zh: 有沒有 MCP server 可以讓我的 agent 設定提醒，並排程某些操作之後再自動執行？

queries.capability: detect embedding drift with optimal transport
queries.quote: Sinkhorn-Knopp solver for embedding drift detection via `lattice-transport`.
queries.en: I want to detect drift between two sets of vector embeddings over time using optimal transport, like Sinkhorn or Wasserstein distance, in Rust.
queries.zh: 想用 optimal transport（Sinkhorn 或 Wasserstein distance）在 Rust 裡偵測兩批 embedding 之間的 drift，有推薦的 library 嗎？

queries.capability: show GitHub pull request status per branch
queries.quote: In the branches panel, lazygit can show which of your branches have an associated GitHub pull request by showing a GitHub icon next to the branch name
queries.en: I want to see, from my terminal, which local branches already have a GitHub pull request open or merged, and jump to the PR quickly.
queries.zh: 想在 terminal 裡直接看到哪些本地 branch 已經有 GitHub pull request（open 或 merged），還能快速打開那個 PR，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: create and switch git worktrees
queries.quote: Press `w` in the branches view to create a worktree from the selected branch and switch to it.
queries.en: Is there an easy terminal interface for creating a git worktree from a branch so I can work on several branches without stashing?
queries.zh: 有沒有好用的終端介面可以從某個 branch 建立 git worktree，同時處理多個 branch 而不用一直 stash？

queries.capability: create and use custom color palettes
queries.quote: Ready to use palettes, or make your own.
queries.en: I need a drawing app with ready-made color palettes for retro graphics, and I want to make my own custom palette too.
queries.zh: 想找一個有現成調色盤的繪圖軟體，也能自己建立自訂 palette。

queries.capability: edit multiple sprites simultaneously
queries.quote: Multiple sprites can be edited at once.
queries.en: Is there a free editor that lets me open and work on multiple small game images simultaneously in one window?
queries.zh: 有沒有免費的編輯器可以同時開啟並編輯多個遊戲小圖檔？

queries.capability: chat with agent through Discord bot
queries.quote: `dispatch` | chat: Discord
queries.en: I want to talk to my AI agent running on my home machine by messaging it from Discord. How can I set that up?
queries.zh: 我想透過 Discord 傳訊息給在我家裡電腦上跑的 AI agent，要怎麼設定？

queries.capability: use agent from Zed editor via ACP
queries.quote: Drive it from the terminal, from Zed ([`localharness acp`](docs/zed.md))
queries.en: Is there a way to plug a self-hosted agent into the Zed editor over ACP so it uses my local model?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法透過 ACP 把自架的 agent 接到 Zed 編輯器裡，用我本機的模型？

queries.capability: send whole directories recursively preserving paths
queries.quote: Directories are collected recursively. Their selected root names and nested paths are preserved on the receiver.
queries.en: I need to send an entire folder with nested subdirectories to another computer on my network, keeping the directory structure intact.
queries.zh: 我想把整個資料夾（含子目錄）傳到同網路的另一台電腦，而且要保留原本的目錄結構，有什麼工具可以用？

queries.capability: pipe stdin text to another device
queries.quote:
To send a text message instead of files, use `--text` together with `--to`.
Pass `-` to read the text from stdin:
queries.en: How can I pipe command output from stdin in my shell straight to my phone on the same Wi-Fi?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法在終端機把指令輸出透過 pipe 從 stdin 直接傳到同一個 Wi-Fi 下的手機？

queries.capability: detect scenes, black frames, silence and split
queries.quote: Detect scenes, black frames and silence, and split by them
queries.en: I want to automatically split a long recording wherever there's silence or black frames, without re-encoding the video.
queries.zh: 想把一段很長的錄影在靜音或黑畫面的地方自動切開，有沒有工具可以做到而且不用重新編碼？

queries.capability: import/export segments as chapters, CSV, EDL
queries.quote: Segments, markers and tags, with import/export of chapters, CSV, EDL and more
queries.en: Is there an app that can import an EDL or CSV list of timestamps and cut a video into those segments?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以匯入 EDL 或 CSV 時間碼清單，然後依照這些片段切割影片？

queries.capability: paste clipboard item without formatting
queries.quote: To choose the history item and paste without formatting, press <kbd>OPTION (⌥)</kbd> + <kbd>SHIFT (⇧)</kbd> + <kbd>ENTER</kbd>
queries.en: On my Mac I want to paste something I copied earlier as plain text, without its formatting. What app can do that?
queries.zh: Mac 上有沒有工具可以把之前複製過的內容用純文字貼上，去掉原本的格式？

queries.capability: ignore password manager copies
queries.quote: By default Maccy will ignore certain copy types that are considered to be confidential
queries.en: I need a Mac clipboard history app that won't record passwords copied from my password manager like 1Password.
queries.zh: 想找 Mac 的剪貼簿紀錄工具，但不要記錄從 1Password 這類密碼管理器複製的密碼。

queries.capability: transcribe imported audio/video files like AMR, OPUS
queries.quote: Smartphone call recordings (AMR, 3GP) and voice messages (OPUS) need no extra tools.
queries.en: I have phone call recordings in AMR and WhatsApp voice messages in OPUS. How can I transcribe them locally on my Mac?
queries.zh: 我有手機通話錄音（AMR）和語音訊息（OPUS），想在 Mac 上離線轉成逐字稿，有什麼工具？

queries.capability: local HTTP API for transcription automation
queries.quote: drive the pipeline headlessly over localhost HTTP. POST an audio file, get a diarized transcript back.
queries.en: I want a localhost HTTP API where I POST an audio file and get back a transcript with speaker labels, all running on my Mac.
queries.zh: 想找一個在 Mac 本機跑的 HTTP API，POST 音檔上去就回傳有區分講者的逐字稿。

queries.capability: dim AirPlay, Sidecar, DisplayLink virtual screens
queries.quote: DisplayLink, Airplay, Sidecar and other virtual screens are supported via shade (overlay) control.
queries.en: My monitor is connected through a DisplayLink dock to my Mac and I can't change its brightness. Is there an app that can dim DisplayLink or Sidecar screens?
queries.zh: 我的螢幕透過 DisplayLink 擴充座接到 Mac，沒辦法調亮度，有沒有 app 可以把 DisplayLink 或 Sidecar 螢幕調暗？

queries.capability: smooth brightness transitions
queries.quote: Supports smooth brightness transitions.
queries.en: I want brightness changes on my Mac's external monitor to fade smoothly instead of jumping in steps. What can do that?
queries.zh: 想讓 Mac 外接螢幕的亮度調整有平滑漸變效果，而不是一格一格跳，有什麼工具可以做到？

queries.capability: auto-unsubscribe from mailing lists
queries.quote: **Lists**: screening a list out sends its one-click unsubscribe once the sender is confirmed.
queries.en: I want an email app that can unsubscribe me from mailing lists with one click when I block them.
queries.zh: 有沒有 email app 可以在我封鎖郵件清單時自動幫我一鍵取消訂閱？

queries.capability: block email tracking pixels
queries.quote: **Pictures on your terms**: pictures are fetched by your own device, and a tracking pixel the blocker recognises is never requested.
queries.en: Is there a mail client that blocks tracking pixels in emails so senders can't tell when I open them?
queries.zh: 想找會擋掉 email 裡 tracking pixel 的郵件客戶端，不讓寄件者知道我有沒有開信。

queries.capability: Tamagotchi-style virtual pet with hunger stats
queries.quote: **Virtual Pet**: Turns your desktop companion into a Tamagotchi-style pet with hunger, affection, and energy levels tracked via a live status pin.
queries.en: I want a Tamagotchi-style virtual pet on my computer screen that tracks hunger, affection, and energy so I have to take care of it.
queries.zh: 有沒有可以在桌面上養的 Tamagotchi 風格電子寵物？要會追蹤飢餓、好感度和體力那種。

queries.capability: diagnose coding agent integration setup
queries.quote: Check whether the Claude hook and project Cursor MCP integrations are installed, need an update, or are broken, and whether the desktop app is reachable:
queries.en: Is there a CLI command that diagnoses whether my Claude hooks and Cursor MCP config are installed correctly or broken, with JSON output?
queries.zh: 想找一個 CLI 指令可以檢查 Claude hook 跟 Cursor 的 MCP 設定有沒有裝好或壞掉，最好能輸出 JSON。

queries.capability: read Modbus RTU industrial energy meters
queries.quote: | Modbus RTU (RS485)   | ✅     | Industrial energy meters, PLCs, motor drives                           |
queries.en: I need something on a Raspberry Pi that reads my energy meters over Modbus RTU RS485 and makes decisions from the readings.
queries.zh: 想在 Raspberry Pi 上透過 Modbus RTU（RS485）讀取工業電表，並根據讀數自動判斷處理，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: send approval requests via WhatsApp/SMS
queries.quote: Tier C actions always require operator approval via WhatsApp/SMS. No config flag to skip it
queries.en: How can my device controller text me on WhatsApp or SMS asking for approval before shutting off equipment, and act only if I reply YES?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法讓設備控制器在關閉設備前，先透過 WhatsApp 或 SMS 傳訊息請我核准，我回覆 YES 才執行？

queries.capability: control coding agents from Android phone
queries.quote:
then pair the oxi Android app (`oxi-android.apk` in each
release) by scanning the QR code. Phones connect over Tailscale
queries.en: I want to check on and control my AI coding agents running on my workstation from my Android phone, ideally over Tailscale.
queries.zh: 想用 Android 手機遠端查看和操控在工作站上跑的 AI coding agent，最好能透過 Tailscale 連線，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: local Whisper voice dictation for prompts
queries.quote: Also: chats saved per workspace, local Whisper voice dictation, web search without an API key
queries.en: Is there an AI coding chat app where I can dictate prompts by voice using a local Whisper model instead of typing?
queries.zh: 有沒有 AI coding 聊天工具可以用本機 Whisper 語音輸入 prompt，不用一直打字？

queries.capability: speaker diarization of audio recordings
queries.quote:
**Nemotron 3 Diarization** (NVIDIA) - who spoke when, overlapping speakers
  included, in recordings up to 10 minutes; the Studio draws it as a speaker
  timeline
queries.en: I need to run speaker diarization locally on a meeting recording to see who spoke when, including overlapping speakers.
queries.zh: 想在本機 GPU 上對會議錄音做 speaker diarization，標出誰在什麼時候講話，重疊的也要能分辨。

queries.capability: predict missing table column without training
queries.quote:
give it labelled rows and it predicts the missing column of
  new ones, with no training
queries.en: I want to self-host a tabular model that predicts a missing column for new rows from labelled examples, without training, for classification or regression.
queries.zh: 有沒有可以自架的 tabular 模型，給它有標籤的資料列，就能直接預測新資料缺的欄位，不用訓練，分類跟 regression 都要。

queries.capability: scan GitHub account for attacker-created repos
queries.quote: Looks for repos created by stolen credentials matching known attack patterns.
queries.en: Can something check my GitHub account for repos that attackers created using my stolen credentials?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以檢查我的 GitHub 帳號裡是否有被盜用憑證建立的可疑 repo？

queries.capability: install git pre-commit hook via husky/lefthook
queries.quote: Auto-detects husky / lefthook / pre-commit / native git hooks and wires patient-zero into the right place.
queries.en: I want a malware check to run automatically on every git commit, hooked into my existing husky or lefthook setup.
queries.zh: 想在每次 git commit 時自動檢查惡意套件，能自動接到我現有的 husky 或 lefthook 設定嗎？

queries.capability: request JSON output matching a schema
queries.quote: Request JSON responses matching a schema:
queries.en: I want to ask an AI coding agent like Codex a question from the command line and get back JSON that conforms to a schema I provide.
queries.zh: 想從 command line 問 Codex 之類的 AI coding agent，並讓它回傳符合我指定 JSON schema 的結果，有工具可以做到嗎？

queries.capability: show background task status in Claude status line
queries.quote: It reads Claude Code's status line JSON on stdin, so it drops straight into `settings.json`:
queries.en: How can I show the progress of a running background AI review in my Claude Code status line?
queries.zh: 想在 Claude Code 的 status line 顯示背景 AI review 任務的執行進度，該怎麼做？

queries.capability: game controller support for iOS games
queries.quote: Run iOS apps and games on Apple Silicon Macs with mouse, keyboard and controller support.
queries.en: I want to play an iPhone game on my M1 Mac using a gamepad controller. How can I get controller support working?
queries.zh: 想在 M1 Mac 上玩 iPhone 遊戲，而且要用手把控制器，有什麼方法可以支援 controller？

queries.capability: connect to existing logged-in browser tabs
queries.quote: The Playwright MCP Chrome Extension allows you to connect to existing browser tabs and leverage your logged-in sessions and browser state.
queries.en: I want my AI agent to control my already open Chrome tabs and use my logged-in sessions instead of launching a fresh browser. How can I do that?
queries.zh: 想讓 AI agent 直接操作我已經開著的 Chrome 分頁，沿用已登入的 session，不要另外開新的瀏覽器，有什麼工具可以做到？

queries.capability: emulate mobile devices like iPhone
queries.quote: device to emulate, for example: "iPhone 15"
queries.en: I need an LLM agent to browse a website as if on an iPhone 15 to check the mobile layout.
queries.zh: 想讓 LLM agent 模擬 iPhone 15 去瀏覽網站，檢查手機版畫面，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: record mobile devices like iPhone
queries.quote: You can use QuickRecorder to record your screens / windows / applications / mobile devices... etc.
queries.en: I need a Mac app that can record my connected iPhone's screen as a video.
queries.zh: 想在 Mac 上錄製接上的 iPhone 手機畫面，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: separate mic and system audio tracks
queries.quote: After turning off, the system sound and sound from microphone will be recorded into two audio tracks and can be edited independently.
queries.en: How can I record my Mac screen with microphone and system sound saved on separate audio tracks for editing?
queries.zh: Mac 錄螢幕時能不能把麥克風跟系統聲音分成兩個音軌，方便後製剪輯？

queries.capability: translate books with DeepL or Yandex
queries.quote: From a single sentence to the entire book—translate instantly.
queries.en: I want a reading app that can translate an entire foreign-language book or single sentences using DeepL while I read.
queries.zh: 有沒有閱讀 app 可以邊讀邊用 DeepL 翻譯整本外文書或單句？

queries.capability: clip web novel chapters into library
queries.quote: **From Web Novel** can reuse your browser session to import selected chapters and their images.
queries.en: How can I clip web pages or import chapters of a web novel, with images, into my reading library for offline reading?
queries.zh: 想把網路小說的章節和圖片匯入閱讀器離線看，有什麼工具可以剪輯網頁？

queries.capability: trigger window actions via URL scheme
queries.quote: Example, from a shell: `open -g "rectangle://execute-action?name=left-half"`
queries.en: On my Mac, how can I script window positioning, like sending the front window to the left half from a shell command or URL?
queries.zh: 在 Mac 上有沒有辦法用 shell 指令或 URL 來控制視窗，例如把目前視窗移到左半邊？

queries.capability: assign mouse side buttons to window actions
queries.quote: A window action's shortcut can be a mouse button instead of a key, such as one of the side buttons found on many mice.
queries.en: I want to use my mouse's side buttons to snap or switch windows on macOS. Any app that lets me bind them?
queries.zh: 想在 macOS 上用滑鼠側鍵來排列或切換視窗，有什麼 app 可以綁定滑鼠按鍵？

queries.capability: run shell commands without sending output to model
queries.quote:
A line starting with `!` runs in your own
shell, in the workspace, and the model never sees it:
queries.en: I want to run shell commands inside my AI coding session without the output going into the model's context, and only attach the results I choose.
queries.zh: 想在 AI coding session 裡直接跑 shell 指令，但輸出不要自動丟給模型，只把我挑的結果 attach 給它，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: split agent between local and cloud providers
queries.quote:
`AGENT_MODEL_PROVIDER` puts one mode on a different provider, so a session runs part local and part
cloud:
queries.en: Is there a coding assistant where planning runs on my local model but the actual file edits go to a cloud model via OpenRouter to save money?
queries.zh: 有沒有 coding agent 可以讓規劃跑本機模型，真正改檔案時才用 OpenRouter 的雲端模型，省 token 費用？

queries.capability: connect MCP servers and Markdown skills
queries.quote:
**MCP and skills** — connect MCP servers and drop Markdown skills into
  `~/.agents/skills` or a project
queries.en: I want a terminal coding assistant that can connect to my MCP servers and load custom Markdown skill files from my project folder.
queries.zh: 想找一個終端機的 coding assistant，可以接我的 MCP servers，還能從專案資料夾載入自訂的 Markdown skills。

queries.capability: sandbox agent shell commands with approvals
queries.quote: one-time or reusable approvals and optional OS sandboxing on macOS and Linux
queries.en: I need an AI coding agent that asks for approvals before running commands and can sandbox them at the OS level on Linux.
queries.zh: 需要一個 AI coding agent，執行指令前會先要求我批准，而且在 Linux 上可以用 OS 層級的 sandbox 隔離。

queries.capability: separate settings for Universal Control devices
queries.quote: each trackpad, mouse, Universal Control device or app.
queries.en: When I use Universal Control from my other Mac's trackpad, scrolling goes the wrong way. Can I set scroll direction separately for Universal Control devices?
queries.zh: 用 Universal Control 從另一台 Mac 的觸控板控制時捲動方向反了，有辦法針對 Universal Control 裝置單獨設定捲動方向嗎？

queries.capability: view live scroll event debug log
queries.quote: To display the debug window, Option(⌥)-click the Scroll Reverser menu bar icon.
queries.en: I want to see a live debug window of incoming scroll events on my Mac to figure out which device is sending them.
queries.zh: 想在 Mac 上即時看到捲動事件的 debug 視窗，找出是哪個裝置送出的事件，有什麼工具？

queries.capability: ingest Gmail threads into searchable store
queries.quote: Stores career docs, interview prep, Krisp transcripts, Slack threads, Gmail, and authored Markdown notes in Postgres + pgvector.
queries.en: I want my Gmail threads, Slack threads and Krisp meeting transcripts pulled into one local searchable database that my AI agent can query.
queries.zh: 想把 Gmail、Slack 討論串和 Krisp 會議逐字稿都匯進本機可搜尋的資料庫，讓 AI agent 可以查詢，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: browse and edit notes in local web UI
queries.quote: `brain ui` is the primary reading surface: a single-user web app over the same corpus. You can browse the tree, search with facets, read a document, and create, edit, move, or delete vault notes
queries.en: Is there a local web app where I can browse, edit, and search my personal notes in a browser, even read them from my phone over LAN?
queries.zh: 有沒有本機跑的 web 介面可以在瀏覽器瀏覽、編輯和搜尋個人筆記，還能用手機透過區網讀取？

queries.capability: persistent memory across agent sessions
queries.quote: A memory system is elemental to long-lived agent workflows, especially when knowledge is to be shared across
queries.en: I want my AI coding agent to keep project memory that persists across sessions and can be shared between users and projects.
queries.zh: 我想讓 AI coding agent 有可以跨 session 保存的專案記憶，還能在不同使用者和專案之間共用。

queries.capability: move files and inline code refactoring
queries.quote: | move (symbol, file, directory)            | --                 | yes                               |
queries.en: Is there a way for my coding agent to move a class to another file and inline functions safely, updating all references automatically?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法讓 coding agent 安全地把 class 移到別的檔案、做 inline 重構，並自動更新所有引用？

queries.capability: import .env keys into process env and secrets
queries.quote:
`shep import env` puts each key it holds, or the narrower set `--only`
names, into one sheep's env, and the ones you name into the secrets store.
queries.en: I want to load variables from a .env file into a supervised service's environment and put the sensitive ones into a secrets store.
queries.zh: 想把 .env 檔裡的變數匯入某個被監管服務的環境變數，敏感的值另外存進 secrets store，有工具可以做嗎？

queries.capability: terminal dashboard for monitoring processes
queries.quote: Four panes over the same selection. `j`/`k` moves, `/` filters, `q` quits.
queries.en: Is there a terminal TUI dashboard that shows my running services, host stats, and their live output in panes?
queries.zh: 有沒有終端機 TUI dashboard，可以分格顯示正在跑的服務、主機狀態跟即時輸出？

queries.capability: stream Mac metrics to remote account
queries.quote: After that Stats starts streaming metrics to your account and is registered to launch automatically at login and restart if it stops.
queries.en: I want to set up a headless Mac over SSH so it streams its system metrics to an online dashboard I can check from any device.
queries.zh: 我想透過 SSH 在一台 headless 的 Mac 上設定遠端監控，把系統數據傳到線上帳號，從任何裝置都能查看。

queries.capability: show stats in macOS desktop widgets
queries.quote: To enable it, the `macOS widgets` option must be enabled in the Stats settings.
queries.en: Is there an app that shows my Mac's system usage in macOS desktop widgets?
queries.zh: 有沒有 app 可以用 macOS 桌面小工具 (widgets) 顯示 Mac 的系統資源使用狀況？

queries.capability: exact Llama tokenization with SentencePiece model
queries.quote: **SentencePiece** exact tokenization for Llama and other open-source models (bring your own `.model` file)
queries.en: I have a Llama tokenizer.model file from HuggingFace. How can I get exact token counts for my documents with it, offline?
queries.zh: 我手上有 Llama 的 SentencePiece tokenizer.model，想在本機離線精確計算文件的 token 數，有什麼工具可以用？

queries.capability: cache repeated directory token counts
queries.quote: Experimental directory cache** — opt-in reuse for repeated recursive counts, with status, clear, verification, and bypass controls
queries.en: I re-count tokens across a big repo often. Is there a tool that caches per-file results so unchanged files aren't re-tokenized?
queries.zh: 我常常要重算整個大型 repo 的 token 數，有沒有工具可以 cache 每個檔案的結果，沒改過的檔案就不用重算？

queries.capability: control actions via URL scheme automation
queries.quote: Every action is also a thaw:// link, so Raycast, Floe, Shortcuts or a shell script can drive Thaw.
queries.en: Is there a Mac utility for hiding status bar icons that I can trigger from Raycast, Apple Shortcuts, or a shell script?
queries.zh: 有沒有 Mac 上隱藏狀態列圖示的工具，可以用 Raycast、Shortcuts 或 shell script 來觸發操作？

queries.capability: search and find items by keystroke
queries.quote: Thaw hides the menu bar items you don't need, brings them back on demand, and finds any of them in a keystroke.
queries.en: I want to quickly search for and open any hidden status bar icon on my Mac with a keyboard shortcut.
queries.zh: 想在 Mac 上用快捷鍵快速搜尋並打開任何被隱藏的狀態列圖示，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: measure inference server cold start time
queries.quote: `throttle coldstart`**: launches your server command and times how long it takes to answer and to send its first token. Repeat `--cmd` to compare engines.
queries.en: How long does my model server take to boot and return its first token? I want to time startup across a couple of serving engines.
queries.zh: 我想量測 model server 從啟動到能回應、送出第一個 token 要多久，順便比較幾個 serving engine 的冷啟動時間。

queries.capability: auto-tune serving config for cheapest cost
queries.quote: `throttle autotune`**: tries serving configs and keeps the cheapest one that is cheaper beyond the noise and whose output did not change shape.
queries.en: Is there a tool that automatically tries different vLLM serving configs and picks the cheapest one without breaking output?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以自動嘗試不同的 vLLM serving config，挑出最便宜又不會讓輸出壞掉的設定？

queries.capability: compose songs with vocals from lyrics
queries.quote: create original songs with vocals and background music, or instrumentals, on your Mac with ACE-Step 1.5 (MIT).
queries.en: I want to generate an original song with vocals from my own lyrics, locally on my Mac, specifying genre, mood and instruments.
queries.zh: 想在自己的 Mac 上本機用我寫的歌詞生成有人聲的原創歌曲，可以指定曲風、情緒和樂器。

queries.capability: burn subtitles into a video
queries.quote: After transcribing a local video, choose **Add subtitles to video…** and pick **Burn subtitles into the video (always visible)** or **Add a subtitle track (viewer can turn on/off)**.
queries.en: How can I automatically generate subtitles from a video's speech and burn them into the video file?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以自動辨識影片語音產生字幕，然後直接把字幕燒進 mp4 影片裡？

queries.capability: shared memory pool across multiple sessions
queries.quote: `--pool-mode shared` pays for the index **once**; each extra session adds only ~30 MB, so 50–70+ sessions fit and CPU becomes the limit
queries.en: I run dozens of LLM agent sessions on one 8 GB machine and want them to share a single memory store so RAM doesn't explode. What can do that?
queries.zh: 我想在一台 8 GB 的機器上跑幾十個 LLM agent session，讓它們共用同一個記憶庫，避免 RAM 爆掉，有什麼工具可以做到？

queries.capability: benchmark agent recall with memory on vs off
queries.quote:
reproduce with
`python -m bench.api_eval --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro --repo microsoft/vscode --arms off,on,on_chain --plot`
queries.en: How can I benchmark an agent's recall and cost over a long session via OpenRouter, comparing with and without a retrieval memory layer?
queries.zh: 我想透過 OpenRouter 做 benchmark，比較長時間 agent session 在有無檢索記憶層時的回憶準確度和成本，該用什麼工具？

queries.capability: reduce background noise before transcription
queries.quote: | `--denoise` | | Reduce background noise before transcription |
queries.en: I want to ask questions out loud to a local LLM from my terminal, but my room is noisy. Is there something that removes background noise before transcribing?
queries.zh: 想在 terminal 用語音問本機 LLM 問題，但環境很吵，有工具能在轉文字前先降噪嗎？

queries.capability: answer questions from FLAC or AIFF recordings
queries.quote: The file can be WAV, AIFF, AIFF-C or FLAC.
queries.en: I have a spoken question saved as a FLAC file. How can I transcribe it and get an answer from a local model in one command?
queries.zh: 我有一個 FLAC 錄音檔，裡面是我口述的問題，怎麼用一個指令轉成文字並讓本機模型回答？

queries.capability: Bazarr subtitle provider backend
queries.quote:
For [Bazarr](https://www.bazarr.media)'s subtitles, `POST /asr` answers as
[whisper-asr-webservice](https://github.com/ahmetoner/whisper-asr-webservice) does
queries.en: I want Bazarr to generate subtitles for my media library using a local speech recognition server instead of a cloud one. What can I point its Whisper provider at?
queries.zh: 我想讓 Bazarr 用本機的語音辨識服務幫影片庫產生字幕，不要用雲端，Whisper provider 可以指向什麼？

queries.capability: JSON output with per-token timestamps
queries.quote: wavo run talk.wav --json              # text and every token with its start time
queries.en: I need a transcript of a recording as JSON with a start timestamp for every token, generated offline on my machine.
queries.zh: 我需要把錄音離線轉成文字，輸出 JSON 格式，而且每個 token 都要有開始時間的 timestamp。

queries.capability: hand off agent checkout to another agent
queries.quote: A handoff moves a checkout to another instance with uncommitted work intact.
queries.en: I want to pass a half-finished coding task from Claude Code to Codex, keeping the uncommitted changes in the checkout. Is there a handoff tool for that?
queries.zh: 我想把 Claude Code 做到一半的工作交接給 Codex，保留 checkout 裡還沒 commit 的變更，有工具可以做這種 handoff 嗎？

queries.capability: let agents use secrets without seeing values
queries.quote: Spaces, scoped secrets that agents use without seeing the value, cross-Space read grants that expire, and approval cards for anything privileged.
queries.en: How can I let AI coding agents use API secrets without exposing the values, and require approval before privileged actions?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法讓 AI coding agent 使用 API secrets 但看不到實際值，而且執行高權限操作前要先經過 approval？

queries.capability: rerank documents against a query
queries.quote: `POST /v1/rerank` scores documents against a query with the model that is already loaded.
queries.en: I need a local HTTP endpoint that can rerank a list of documents against a search query using a model I'm already running.
queries.zh: 我想要一個本地的 HTTP endpoint，可以用已經在跑的模型針對查詢對一批文件做 rerank。

queries.capability: watermark generated text and detect it
queries.quote:
a text
watermark with its detector (`--watermark`, `runner attest detect`).
queries.en: How can I add a watermark to text generated by my local LLM and later detect whether a passage carries it?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法在本地 LLM 產生的文字裡加上 watermark，之後再偵測某段文字是不是它產生的？

queries.capability: detect tampering in repo enforcement files
queries.quote: On drift it writes `GIAMTHI_HALT.lock`. A hook that runs first on every tool call then denies everything while the lock exists.
queries.en: I want a scheduled watcher that detects if someone tampers with my repo's hook config or CI workflows and then halts all AI agent tool calls.
queries.zh: 想要一個排程監控，偵測 repo 裡的 hook 設定或 CI workflow 被竄改時，就自動停止所有 AI agent 的 tool call。

queries.capability: block destructive shell commands like rm -rf
queries.quote: `guard-destructive.sh` blocks `rm -rf`, force-push, `DROP TABLE` and similar.
queries.en: How can I stop my coding agent from running destructive commands like rm -rf, force-push, or DROP TABLE?
queries.zh: 怎麼防止 coding agent 執行 rm -rf、force-push 或 DROP TABLE 這類破壞性指令？

queries.capability: preview images in terminal via Sixel/Kitty protocols
queries.quote: 🖼️ **Built-in Support for Multiple Image Protocols**: Also integrated with Überzug++ and Chafa, covering almost all terminals.
queries.en: I want to see image thumbnails directly inside my terminal while browsing folders, ideally using Sixel or the Kitty graphics protocol.
queries.zh: 想在 terminal 裡瀏覽資料夾時直接看到圖片預覽，最好支援 Sixel 或 Kitty graphics protocol，有推薦的工具嗎？

queries.capability: jump to directories with zoxide and fzf
queries.quote: 🧰 Integration with ripgrep, fd, fzf, zoxide, [Rclone](https://github.com/yazi-rs/plugins/tree/main/rclone.yazi)
queries.en: Looking for a terminal file browser that integrates with zoxide and fzf so I can fuzzy-jump to directories quickly.
queries.zh: 有沒有可以整合 zoxide 跟 fzf 的 terminal 檔案瀏覽器，讓我能用模糊搜尋快速跳到資料夾？

queries.capability: access terminal sessions via built-in web client
queries.quote: Zellij includes a built-in [web-client](https://zellij.dev/tutorials/web-client/), making a terminal optional.
queries.en: I want to open and use my persistent shell sessions from a web browser without needing a terminal emulator. What tool can do that?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以讓我直接用瀏覽器開啟並操作我的 shell session，不需要另外裝 terminal emulator？
